sources.title: A Trend Following Deep Dive: AlphaTrend and Agentic Research Workflows
sources.authors: Martin Luk; Tarek Abou Zeid; Otto van Hemert; Man Group
sources.claim: Specialised, predefined agentic research pipelines can trade breadth for depth, rapidly eliminate weak research paths and accelerate robust signal evaluation, while still requiring multiple-testing discipline and human governance.

sources.title: A Trend Following Deep Dive: The Optimal Market Mix for a Trend Follower
sources.authors: Harry Moore; Rupert Goodall; Man AHL
sources.claim: The optimal opportunity set depends on the investor objective; market breadth, liquidity, crisis behaviour and capital efficiency should be optimised jointly rather than maximising standalone Sharpe only.

sources.title: A Trend Following Deep Dive: Cash (Equities) Is King
sources.authors: Giuliana Bordigoni; Max Buchanan; Man Group
sources.claim: Cross-sectional and cash-equity trend opportunities can broaden the independent opportunity set beyond index futures and may add diversification when liquidity and implementation permit.

sources.title: The Need for Speed in Trend-Following Strategies
sources.claim: Fast and slow trend systems capture different trend lengths and can be lowly correlated; faster systems can improve crisis responsiveness but are more sensitive to transaction costs and execution quality.

sources.title: How Do Investors Form Long-Run Return Expectations?
sources.claim: Objective yield/valuation-based expected returns and subjective rear-view-mirror expectations can diverge materially; extrapolative expectations may be most dangerous near major market peaks and troughs.

sources.title: Machine Learning and the Implementable Efficient Frontier
sources.authors: Theis Ingerslev Jensen; Bryan T. Kelly; Semyon Malamud; Lasse H. Pedersen
sources.claim: Machine-learning portfolio construction should optimise an economic objective net of trading costs; learning portfolio weights directly can improve implementable outcomes and permits economic feature-importance attribution.

sources.title: Adaptive Conformal Inference for Multi-Step Ahead Time-Series Forecasting Online
sources.claim: Adaptive conformal inference can update uncertainty coverage online for multi-step time-series forecasts under non-exchangeability; target error and learning rates can differ by forecast horizon.

sources.title: Online Conformal Model Selection for Nonstationary Time Series
sources.claim: For nonstationary time series, an online confidence set of candidate models can adapt to changing dynamics and retain the best model with a controlled long-run coverage target rather than forcing a single fixed champion.

sources.title: Bayesian Autoregressive Online Change-Point Detection with Time-Varying Parameters
sources.authors: Ioanna-Yvonni Tsaknaki; Fabrizio Lillo; Piero Mazzarisi
sources.claim: Online Bayesian change-point detection can model autocorrelation plus time-varying variance/correlation within regimes and provide probabilistic warnings of structural changes in nonstationary time series.

sources.title: Online Learning of Order Flow and Market Impact with Bayesian Change-Point Detection Methods
sources.authors: Ioanna-Yvonni Tsaknaki; Fabrizio Lillo; Piero Mazzarisi
sources.claim: Regime-aware Bayesian change-point models can improve online predictions of persistent order flow and market impact relative to models that ignore regime shifts in the studied NASDAQ data.

rules.hypothesis: Use specialised research pipelines with fixed nodes and separate validation instead of one universal research agent.
rules.mechanism: Specialisation trades flexibility for depth and reduces attention dilution.
rules.formalization_note: Governance only; new specialists stay shadow until measured.

rules.hypothesis: Optimise the opportunity set against the actual portfolio objective, including liquidity, crisis behaviour and capital efficiency.
rules.mechanism: Diversification quality depends on the objective and the independent opportunity set.
rules.formalization_note: Portfolio governance; not a directional signal.

rules.hypothesis: Test cross-sectional relative-value trend signals separately from directional index trend.
rules.mechanism: Cross-sectional trends can provide a distinct source of diversification.
rules.formalization_note: Requires security/sector breadth data before decision influence.

rules.hypothesis: Maintain fast, medium and slow trend components and evaluate their incremental value net of turnover costs.
rules.mechanism: Different trend speeds capture different persistence lengths and crisis responsiveness.
rules.formalization_note: v70.1 initially uses transparent horizon-group proxy; separate within-horizon speeds require validation.

rules.hypothesis: Separate objective valuation/yield expectations from extrapolative narrative expectations.
rules.mechanism: Subjective expectations may extrapolate past returns while objective starting yields can imply the opposite.
rules.formalization_note: Requires external consensus/survey feed for true expectation-gap decisions.

rules.hypothesis: Judge model improvements by net economic utility after costs, not forecast accuracy alone.
rules.mechanism: Decision-focused learning aligns model training and feature importance with implementable portfolio outcomes.
rules.formalization_note: Governance for Learning Index 3.0 and layer attribution.

rules.hypothesis: Add adaptive forecast-coverage diagnostics separately for each horizon once explicit point forecasts and errors are stored.
rules.mechanism: Adaptive conformal methods update uncertainty coverage online under distribution shift.
rules.formalization_note: DATA_REQUIRED until explicit forecast-error series exists; do not label heuristics as conformal.

rules.hypothesis: Prefer an adaptive confidence set of models under nonstationarity over a permanently fixed single champion.
rules.mechanism: The identity of the best model changes when time-series dynamics change.
rules.formalization_note: Shadow research until online model-set coverage is validated.

rules.hypothesis: Research probabilistic online regime-change warnings that account for autocorrelation and time-varying volatility.
rules.mechanism: Change points can mark structural shifts in mean/dynamics before static regime labels fully adjust.
rules.formalization_note: Shadow only until sequential change-point calibration is complete.

rules.hypothesis: When licensed microstructure data become available, model order-flow regimes and market impact jointly rather than assuming stationary flow.
rules.mechanism: Persistent order flow can change regimes and alter short-run price impact.
